paper_title: Search for sub-eV axion-like particles in a quasi-parallel stimulated resonant photon-photon collider with "coronagraphy"
coupling_convention: g/M in GeV^-1 (ALP-photon coupling g_agamma), as plotted on y-axis of Fig. 11
notes: SAPPHIRES02 laser-based stimulated resonant photon-photon collider search for sub-eV ALPs. Null result yields a new 95% CL exclusion region in the g/M vs m plane for both scalar and pseudoscalar ALPs (Figs. 10-11), spanning roughly 1e-3 to 1 eV in mass. Only one explicit numerical value is quoted in the text: the most sensitive point g/M = 5.45e-7 GeV^-1 at m = 0.15 eV (pseudoscalar). Full exclusion curve is only available as figures, not tables, so only the single text-quoted point is extracted.
